card.name: Malaria prophylaxis and travel wording
card.fires_on: Words in malaria-prevention text about travel: mefloquine name parts, traveler terms, and endemic area wording. It fires on the marked word inside or just after these terms.

modes.label: Inside mefloquine and prophylaxis
modes.description: Partway through the drug name mefloquine or the word chemoprophylaxis.
modes.example: Vaccinations with attenuated live bacteria should therefore be completed at least 3 days before the first dose of me<<flo>>quine hydrochloride tablets.

modes.label: Traveler words
modes.description: Travel or traveler terms in malaria advice.
modes.example: effects of mefloquine on<< travelers>> receiving concomitant medications

modes.label: Endemic area wording
modes.description: The word area or a linking word after travel to or in an endemic region.
modes.example: Prophylactic drug administration should begin 1 week before arrival in an endemic<< area>>.

card.writes: It adds little clear output; the promoted tokens are a loose mix of travel, camping and missionary words.
card.plain: It lights up in malaria-prevention advice for people travelling to risky regions.
